jobs.title: Associate Consult Partner
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses.  We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

The Role

Your Role
Kyndryl Consult is the fastest growing business within the organization and instrumental to the company’s strategic growth objectives. You will play a key leadership role across multi-disciplinary teams, guiding them through complex consulting engagements and be responsible for creating and positioning strategic change agendas within Kyndryl's largest accounts across the C-suite, spanning the intersection between complex Business and IT customer solutions, transformations that impact across the entire customer Eco-system.

What you will do
As a Consult Partner, you will have a pivotal role in driving profitable growth, leveraging our comprehensive capabilities to build strong client relationships, and leading your team to success. This role demands a strong presence, industry expertise, and the ability to cultivate relationships with CXO-level clients. Your leadership will be critical in fostering talent development and innovation within the organization.

This role of will also be leading the overall client engagement and delivering high quality client work alongside senior client stakeholders. Working in a transaction environment which may be pre or post deal, planning post deal implementation, and ultimately supporting execution. Partners will be focused on financial impact, utilization and contribution, client impact and leadership.

Contribute to Profitable Growth:
•Drive significant financial outcomes through signings and revenue targets
•Ensure sustained growth and profitability, managing margin expectations and backlog growth
•Support the identification, pursuit and conversion of a pipeline of business development opportunities
•Undertake scoping and fee negotiation on engagements, while enduring profitability and understanding and containing risk

Client Engagement:
•Build and maintain deep relationships with client CXOs and be seen as the 'go to' person and a trusted advisor by senior executives
•Leading C-level client interactions and consulting initiatives, deliverables and outputs of a deal engagement
•Demonstrate credibility and experience to advise and deliver on complex consulting engagement
•Enhance client satisfaction, as measured by Net Promoter Score (NPS) and new relationship development; Secure client references

Operational Excellence:
•Achieve individual and team utilization targets
•Lead the design of complex engagements and take responsibility for oversight of delivery, ensuring high performance and customer satisfaction
Leadership, Management, People
•Lead by example; Fostering a culture of continuous personal and professional development and challenging our people to be curious and innovative and supportive for each other. At the same time ensuring that all outcomes are commercially focused, value adding and effectively executed

Strategic Contribution:
•Utilize industry and technology expertise to shape and drive the company’s strategic initiatives.
•Align with Kyndryl’s strategic vision and contribute to its execution.
•Drive external eminence and innovation, establishing a strong personal and organizational brand in the industry.
•Proactively develop thought leadership and intellectual capital

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience
•15+ yrs of Extensive experience in client engagement and relationship management at the CXO level
•Demonstrable ability to build and commercialize relationships with senior executives
•Proven track record of leading and executing complex projects with multi-disciplinary teams in a consulting, corporate or public sector environment
•Effective financial acumen with experience in driving revenue growth and managing margins
•Experience of managing or supporting high-value business development activities with senior stakeholders
•Deep understanding of industry trends and technology
•Sound personal brand and presence in the industry
•Demonstrated ability to innovate and drive change

Preferred Skills and Experience

•Leadership: self-starter mindset and with client and Kyndryl outcomes top of mind. Ability to mentor and mentee, create an environment and workplace of choice for peers and team members, be the role model of professional excellence
•Execution: Possesses critical thinking capabilities to analyze data and inputs with objectivity and provide strategic roadmaps and recommendations. Always intellectually curious an brings innovative ideas to solve critical business problems. Clearly accountable on commitments. Able to pivot change in client and business priorities and manage work across multiple projects and teams
•Bachelor's degree or Master’s degree

Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose.  We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Answers Relevance
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

At Reddit, machine learning sits at the heart of how millions of people discover, connect, and engage with the world’s largest collection of human conversations. From “How do I fix a leaky faucet?” to “What should I watch next?”, the Answers Relevance team leverages AI to connect people with the real-world wisdom of Reddit communities. We’re hiring Senior and Staff Machine Learning Engineers to make Answers smarter, more relevant, and more helpful. Our SOTA AI systems helps surface the right conversations, but the heart of Answers is still people helping people ~ Redditors sharing what they know with each other!

What You’ll Work On
You’ll lead ML projects from idea to production, partnering with Product, Data Science, and Engineering across recommendations, search, messaging, and AI systems.

You don’t need experience in every area listed below. A background in a few may make you a great fit!

• Recommendations, search, content understanding, or large-scale data and ML infrastructure

• SOTA large scale RecSys

• Foundational retriever models

• RAG systems, retrieval methods, LLM evaluation, or production LLM features

• Agentic AI, such as tool calls, MCPs, multi-agent systems, or orchestration

• Self-hosted open-weight models such as Qwen or Llama; prompt engineering, fine-tuning, post-training, or prompt optimization

• Improving grounding, instruction following, and hallucination; evaluating retrieval and generation quality

• Scaling LLM systems, including latency, caching, and cost; safety measures for prompt injection and unsafe inputs

• Defining product success metrics, feedback loops, and evaluation approaches, including human review

What You’ll Do

• Build and improve large-scale ML systems, including retrieval and ranking, embeddings, and LLM-powered features

• Set technical direction and deliver measurable user and business impact

• Work with partner teams to shape product and technical roadmaps

• Evaluate new AI/ML approaches and support responsible LLM development

• Mentor engineers and contribute to long-term ML planning

Required Qualifications

• 4–12 years of experience building, deploying, and operating ML systems in production

• Broad knowledge of ML fundamentals and experience applying them in production; expert-level modeling depth isn’t required

• Experience developing and productionizing models with TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers

• Experience writing production-quality code, including testing, evaluation, and monitoring; Python experience required, Golang experience a plus

• Experience with ML systems such as data pipelines, feature engineering, model training and serving, and production monitoring

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, and a record of delivering measurable product impact

Benefits

• 401k with Employer Match

• Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

• Family Planning Support

• Gender-Affirming Care

• Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

• Troubleshoot, diagnose and resolve network problems. Research, analyze and recommend the implementation of software or hardware changes to rectify any network deficiencies or to enhance network performance.
• Provides support for network connectivity or related network issues for both internal and external customers. Serve as technical resource on a functional basis for the resolution of complex network problems.
• Participate in various client projects intended to continually improve/upgrade network infrastructures. Regularly interface with technical and business staff and external customers.

• Participates in on-call Tier 3 production support activities. Is expected to have the technical knowledge and capability to handle most problems that may arise.

• Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Computer Engineering or discipline related to functional work or role with 5-7 years of relevant work experience OR demonstrated ability to meet the job requirements through a comparable number of years of applicable work experience.
• Must have strong organizational skills with the ability to multi-task various initiatives and activities.
• Able to apply broad work experience and knowledge when analyzing complex problems.
• Must be able consistently identify critical elements, variables and alternatives to develop solutions.
• Must be able to organize/prioritize existing resources and incorporate new information, as needed, to implement the most effective solutions.
• Requires excellent communication skills with ability to state messages in a clear manner by using language that is easy for others to understand.

• 3 + years’ experience in Palo Alto
• Strong understanding of WAN Technologies including MPLS, DS3, Ethernet and broadband

jobs.title: Onsite - Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) / Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN)/ Medical Assistant (MA)
jobs.description:
FLAGLER HEALTH IS BUILDING THE CLINICAL OPERATING SYSTEM FOR MODERN MUSCULOSKELETAL CARE.

We partner with MSK provider groups and specialty clinics to help them grow, operate more efficiently, and deliver better longitudinal care across patient acquisition, clinical workflows, and ongoing patient engagement. Our platform sits at the intersection of care delivery and clinic operations, helping providers capture more value across the full patient lifecycle.

We’ve recently raised our Series B https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260810011327/en/Flagler-Health-Raises-%2450-Million-Series-B-to-Build-the-AI-Operating-System-for-Musculoskeletal-Care and are entering our next phase of growth. 


ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a dedicated and clinically grounded LPN or LVN to serve in a dual-function role at our 320 West Ohio Street, Suite 3W, Chicago, Illinois 60654 facility. You will serve as the on-site point of contact for our Medicare 855B site inspection process and support our Chronic Care Management (CCM) program.



This position is currently 5 days per week, on-site at 320 West Ohio Street, Suite 3W, Chicago, Illinois 606545. As our clinical program scales and staffing grows, a hybrid schedule (rotating in-office and remote days) will become available. That transition will be communicated in advance with clear expectations.



Physical presence during the 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM window is mandatory. Our facility is subject to unannounced CMS / MAC site inspections as part of a pending 855B application. A missed inspection results in automatic application denial. Punctuality and consistency are non-negotiable in this role.




ON-SITE RESPONSIBILITIES


MEDICARE SITE INSPECTION COMPLIANCE

 - Serve as the sole dedicated physical presence at the facility during all posted operating hours.

 - Act as the immediate, professional point of contact when a MAC field inspector arrives unannounced.

 - Escort inspectors through the facility and respond to operational questions factually and without elaboration.

 - Confirm each morning that the facility is open, utilities are operational, and equipment is functioning before 10:00 AM.

 - Verify that external business signage is visible and in compliance.

 - Maintain strict physical HIPAA compliance, including locked medical records storage and secured server areas.

 - Maintain the Readiness Binder at the front desk at all times, containing:

 - Active state facility licenses

 - IRS CP-575 forms

 - Current building lease

 - Copy of the submitted 855B application




CLINICAL RESPONSIBILITIES: CHRONIC CARE MANAGEMENT (CCM)

These duties are performed during on-site hours when inspection coverage permits and will expand to full-time remote clinical work as the hybrid schedule is introduced.



 - Facilitate patient enrollment into Flagler's CCM portal.

 - Make daily outbound calls and send text messages to patients to document health status and maintain engagement.

 - Collect and document patient health information, including medical histories, current health status, and new or evolving symptoms.

 - Send evidence-based health support resources to patients, including stretching guides, light exercise videos, and meditation content.

 - Participate in ongoing company training sessions and team check-ins.

 - Maintain strict patient confidentiality in full compliance with HIPAA regulations and Flagler company policies.




REQUIREMENTS


CREDENTIALS

EXPERIENCE

jobs.title: Lead Recruiter
jobs.description:
This is a fully on-site position, Monday through Friday, at our corporate HQ in Midtown (ATL GA)

About Carvana

At Carvana, we’re changing the way people buy and sell cars. With an ambitious vision and a fundamentally different approach designed to be fun, fast, and fair, Carvana became the fastest-growing automotive retailer in history. We expanded nationally, went public on the New York Stock Exchange, sold our 1 millionth car, and reached the Fortune 500, all in just eight years.

Today, with 4 million retail customers and counting, Carvana is both the fastest-growing and the most profitable public automotive retailer, and we’re just getting started. We continue to raise the bar for our customers as we tackle the enormous opportunity still ahead in the largest consumer vertical.

Working here means being part of a team that embraces change, celebrates creative problem solving, and always strives to be better. At Carvana, you’ll have the opportunity to take on meaningful challenges, learn quickly, and help shape the future of automotive retail. If you’re driven to grow and make an impact as part of a collaborative team, you’ll fit right in. Learn more about what it’s like to work here from the people that already do.

About the team and position

We’re looking for an experienced, high-performing Lead Recruiter to join our Reconditioning Talent Acquisition (Ops TA) team.

In this role, you’ll be the dedicated recruiting partner for 1-3 Reconditioning sites, depending on site size. You’ll own full-cycle recruitment for site leadership roles and support hiring across a broad range of other roles. You’ll build strong relationships with Recon leaders, advise on hiring strategy, and use your understanding of the business and the local talent landscape to build proactive, creative pipelines that keep your sites fully staffed with high-quality talent.

As the team grows, you may also have the opportunity to lead and develop a small team. You’ll set the standard for recruiting excellence, coach others on sourcing and candidate experience, and help shape how Ops TA hires at scale. You’ll see the impact of your work every day, in a company that has been changing the game since 2013 and isn’t slowing down.

What you’ll be doing

• Own full-cycle recruitment for your assigned Reconditioning sites, from intake to start date. You’re accountable for site leadership hires and for the pipeline that keeps hourly roles filled, directly and through your team.

• Lead, coach, and develop 1-2 recruiters. Set clear goals, give regular feedback, and build development plans. Onboard new team members and help them hit their KPIs.

• Act as a strategic talent advisor to Recon leaders. Run intake sessions, forecast staffing needs, and shape hiring plans using market and local labor data.

• Build proactive, multi-channel pipelines, including sourcing, referrals, community and trade-school partnerships, and events, so sites are never starting from zero.

• Guide hiring managers on assessment, interview structure, and offer decisions, and lead the search for hard-to-fill and leadership roles.

• Manage workload and priorities across your team and sites, deciding which searches you own and which you delegate.

• Deliver a strong candidate experience from first contact through start date, and manage the pre-hire process (background checks, DOT/MVR) to reduce drop-off before day one.

• Own recruiting metrics for your sites and team, including time-to-fill, pipeline health, offer acceptance, and quality of hire. Report trends and recommendations to TA leadership.

• Raise the bar for Ops TA. Model best practices, hold your team to a high standard on sourcing quality and candidate experience, and pilot improvements to the hiring process.

• Partner with Talent Development, HR Operations, and Operations leadership to turn talent needs into quality hires and smooth onboarding.

• is includes onboarding and training new team members and helping them meet their KPIs.

What you should have/know

• Bachelor’s degree from an accredited undergraduate institution.

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including 2+ years in high-volume or hourly hiring.

• 1+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing others, formally or informally. This could be direct reports, a team lead role, or training and coaching other recruiters.

• Experience recruiting for a broad spectrum of roles, including leadership and support roles.

• Experience expertly sourcing talent and/or using talent-sourcing platforms.

• Experience working with an ATS, preferably Greenhouse.

• Exceptional interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

• Energy and drive to accomplish goals, meet deadlines, and find solutions.

It would be great if you also have

• Experience specifically in high-volume recruiting (2+ years preferred).

• Recruiting experience in the automotive industry.

• Experience leading, mentoring, and/or developing others.

Don't Meet 100% of the Qualifications?

At Carvana, we value diverse backgrounds and experiences. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't fit every single bullet point. Give it a shot—we'd love to hear from you!

What we’ll offer in return

• Full-Time salary position with a competitive salary.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.

• 401K with company match.

• A multitude of perks including student loan payments, discounts on vehicles, benefits for your pets, and much more.

• A great wellness program to keep you healthy and happy both physically and mentally.

• Access to opportunities to expand your skill set and share your knowledge with others across the organization.

• A company culture focused on high performance and bar-raising, with vast opportunity to learn and grow.

Other requirements

To be able to do your job at Carvana, there are some basic requirements we want to share with you.

• Must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.

Of course, we’ll make any reasonable accommodations for those with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their jobs.

Legal stuff

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check.  This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer.  All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, age, mental or physical disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.  Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

jobs.description:
About Us: EvolutionIQ builds AI that helps insurance claims teams handle claims more accurately, fairly, and efficiently, so more people impacted by injury or illness can get back to their lives with dignity and stability. As part of CCC Intelligent Solutions (NASDAQ: CCC), we pair AI-native product development with something almost no one else in this market has: 40 years of proprietary data and deep relationships with the largest, most complex carriers in the world. It's a rare combination, and it's what lets us build products others can't. Our people come first, and we think it shows. We've been named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces three years running, plus Built In's Best Places to Work in 2025 and 2026.

About the Role: As a Senior Technical Recruiter / TA Partner, you will own full-cycle recruiting for complex, high-impact Engineering and AI positions. You will lead searches for Senior Software Engineers, AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and other specialized technical talent, partnering closely with Engineering leaders to understand their teams, technical requirements, and hiring priorities. You will bring a hands-on sourcing approach, strong technical recruiting judgment, and market intelligence to build exceptional pipelines and deliver high-quality hires.

The ideal candidate is an experienced technical recruiter who can independently manage difficult Engineering searches, engage passive technical talent, and advise hiring managers on realistic talent profiles, competitive markets, and effective selection processes. You can speak credibly with engineers about their work and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment.

Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Technical Recruitment

• Own searches end to end for Engineering and AI teams, including Senior Software Engineers, AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and other specialized technical positions.

• Partner with Engineering hiring managers to translate technical requirements into clear candidate profiles, interview plans, and targeted search strategies.

• Lead recruiter screens and assess relevant technical experience, project ownership, problem-solving approach, career motivations, and alignment with role requirements.

• Manage complex searches proactively, identifying bottlenecks, calibrating with interview teams, and keeping high-priority hiring processes moving.

Technical Talent Acquisition Strategy

• Develop search strategies for hard-to-fill technical roles using talent mapping, competitive intelligence, sourcing data, and a deep understanding of Engineering talent markets.

• Advise Engineering leaders on candidate availability, compensation expectations, market competition, hiring tradeoffs, and realistic recruiting timelines.

• Work with stakeholders to prioritize openings, align on must-have versus trainable skills, and refine candidate profiles based on market feedback.

• Use pipeline data, interviewer feedback, and market insights to continuously adjust sourcing and hiring strategies.

Technical Sourcing and Candidate Engagement

• Personally source and engage passive Engineering talent using LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, Boolean/X-ray search, technical communities, referrals, networking, and relevant AI-enabled sourcing tools.

• Build credible relationships with technical candidates by communicating the Engineering challenges, product impact, team environment, and opportunity for growth.

• Develop and maintain talent pipelines for Software Engineering, AI/ML, and emerging technical skill sets to support current and anticipated hiring needs.

Engineering Partnership and Stakeholder Management

• Build trusted relationships with Engineering leaders, interviewers, HR partners, and other stakeholders to understand organizational goals and evolving technical needs.

• Provide concise, data-driven updates on search progress, pipeline quality, candidate engagement, interview conversion, and risks to hiring goals.

• Influence hiring decisions through structured feedback, thoughtful calibration, and a strong candidate and hiring-manager experience.

Recruiting Analytics and Process Excellence

• Track funnel conversion, sourcing channel effectiveness, time to fill, and offer outcomes; translate findings into actions that improve technical hiring results.

• Partner with Engineering teams to improve interview quality, assessment consistency, candidate communication, and overall process efficiency.

• Stay current on software engineering, AI/ML hiring trends, recruiting technology, and responsible use of AI tools in sourcing and recruiting workflows.

Mentorship

• Share technical recruiting expertise, sourcing methods, and stakeholder-management practices with other recruiters to elevate team performance.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field

• 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including significant direct ownership of Software Engineering and other technical searches at the mid-to-senior level.

• Demonstrated success hiring Senior Software Engineers and related Engineering talent; experience recruiting AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, or similarly specialized roles strongly preferred.

• Advanced hands-on technical sourcing skills, including Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, GitHub, talent mapping, and proactive outreach to passive candidates.

• Ability to discuss technical profiles credibly with Engineering leaders, understand common software development and AI/ML concepts, and translate requirements into an effective recruiting strategy.

• Strong consultative, analytical, communication, and negotiation skills with a track record of managing multiple high-priority technical searches.

Work-life, Culture & Perks:

• Well-Being: Medical, dental, vision, short & long-term disability, life insurance and AD&D, and 401k matching. Additional family, wellness, and pet benefits.

jobs.title: BIM Specialist
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

BIM SPECIALIST

Building on the rapid advancement of the Starlink program, we are moving into a new phase of facility and infrastructure growth. We are currently seeking a BIM Specialist to lead the integration and coordination of Building Information Modeling (BIM) across fast-paced multidisciplinary projects, ensuring project objectives are met through effective model management and collaboration. This position will serve as a key technical resource, supporting project teams and fostering strong BIM practices throughout the project lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop and maintain detailed 3D BIM models using industry-standard software (Revit, Navisworks, AutoCad) for architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), and other engineering disciplines

• Perform clash detection, model coordination, and constructability reviews to identify and resolve conflicts early in the design and construction phases

• Lead BIM coordination efforts for multi-disciplinary projects, ensuring the seamless integration of models and data. Specifically, this will be a mix of in-house processes/elements and external design consultants throughout the whole project lifecycle

• Collaborate closely with project stakeholders to establish and maintain BIM standards, protocols, and workflows

• Act as the primary BIM resource for team members, internal customers and external design consultants, addressing technical issues and optimizing BIM processes for project success

• Work with with the design and construction teams to keep a living model that will culminate in an as-built of the facility at hand

• Lead the transition of BIM workflows from third-party providers to in-house operations, including data migration, process documentation, and training of team members

• Generate accurate construction documentation, quantity takeoffs, and visualizations to support project bidding, procurement, and on-site execution

• Troubleshoot technical issues in BIM environments and recommend software/tools/process improvements to enhance efficiency

• Participate in cross-functional meetings, providing BIM expertise to inform design decisions and mitigate risks

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in architecture, engineering or construction management

• 3+ years of hands-on experience as a BIM specialist or Modeler in a construction or engineering environment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• 5+ years of professional experience in BIM coordination, with multidisciplinary experience on high rise projects

• Experience modeling multiple disciplines (e.g., architecture, structural, MEP).

• Exposure to high rise construction projects is strongly preferred. The ideal candidate will have owned BIM coordination through construction administration on multiple large scale projects and have a solid understanding of means and methods of construction

• Experience in aerospace, high-tech manufacturing, or mission-critical facilities projects.

• Proficiency in BIM authoring and coordination tools, including Revit (advanced level), Navisworks, and related plugins; familiarity with Dynamo or similar scripting for automation.

• Strong understanding of interdisciplinary coordination workflows, clash detection, and federated modeling in large-scale projects.

• Demonstrated expertise in architectural, engineering or MEP-focused BIM workflows, with the ability to drive project success through effective model coordination and communication.

• Certification in BIM (e.g., Autodesk Certified Professional in Revit for Architectural Design/Structure/MEP, or AGC BIM Certificate).

• Knowledge of advanced BIM integrations, such as reality capture (e.g., laser scanning with Trimble or Leica), VR/AR visualizations, or cloud-based collaboration platforms (e.g., Autodesk BIM 360/ACC).

• Design experience in architecture, engineering or a related field

• Familiarity with structural analysis tools and integration of BIM data for structural engineering applications.

• Experience with Siemens NX

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be available to work extended hours and weekends when needed, based on site operational needs; flexibility is required

• Occasional travel may be required based on specific projects; travel requirement is up to 15%

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

• To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Associate Creative Director, Global Retail Experience
jobs.description:
Our Story

Launched in 2015, Sol de Janeiro is a globally recognized, award-winning beauty brand, drawing inspiration from Brazil’s beauty rituals, warmth, and spirit. Sol de Janeiro delivers a sensory experience beloved by multi-generational consumers worldwide, with clinically proven results, transformative textures, and transportive fragrances.

Headquartered in New York and launched as a digitally native brand, we have expanded globally with teams in Paris, London, and Germany. Our commitment to excellence has earned high-profile honors, including being named one of TIME100’s 2024 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s 2024 World's Most Innovative Companies, and WWD Beauty Inc’s Power Brands of 2024, underscoring its leadership in the beauty industry and outstanding workplace. These accolades highlight our dedication to being a leading brand in the beauty industry and an exceptional workplace.

What You’ll Do

The Associate Creative Director, Global Retail Experience, will be at the forefront of shaping Sol de Janeiro’s in-store experiences and retail design, driving the creation of flagship locations, innovative retail models, and dynamic go-to-market activations. This role is all about blending experiential, digital, and immersive storytelling to deliver unforgettable, brand-defining installations. The ideal candidate will be a true champion of brand equity, ensuring every execution upholds our core values and standards.

Working closely with Global Visual Merchandising, Consumer Engagement, and Regional partners, this role translates creative vision into functional, scalable retail concepts: from flagships, pop-ups and department stores to travel retail and new market entries. The ideal candidate combines design precision with storytelling instinct, balancing creativity with executional rigor.

This role reports into the Vice President, Global Retail.

What You’ll Be Working On

• Design and deliver global store concepts that express brand storytelling through spatial, material, and experiential detail.

• Partner with Global VM and Commercial teams to ensure design solutions support business objectives and local retail realities.

• Develop fixture systems, material libraries, and scalable design toolkits adaptable for diverse retail formats.

• Translate creative briefs into 2D and 3D renderings, technical drawings, and production-ready documentation.

• Collaborate with Regional teams and vendors to ensure design intent is executed consistently across markets.

• Participate in concept development for new formats (flagship, pop-up, department store, and travel retail).

• Contribute to the Global Retail Playbook and Fixture Sourcebook, maintaining high-quality standards and clarity for all partners.

• Partner with Global PMO to track project timelines, deliverables, and cost parameters.

• Champion craft, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration throughout every phase of design.

LEADERSHIP FUNCTIONS

• Mentor design team partners; model curiosity, precision, and accountability.

• Collaborate closely with the VP, Global Retail to ensure alignment with overall retail experience strategy.

• Build productive relationships across Global Marketing, Global Creative, Visual Merchandising, Creative Operations, and Regional stakeholders.

• Foster a culture of creative problem-solving, agility, and respect for both aesthetic and operational excellence.

Must Haves

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or related field.

• 8–10 years of experience in retail design, environmental design, or related creative field.

jobs.title: Tax Resolution Advocate
jobs.location: Denver, CO - Hybrid; Los Angeles, CA - Remote; Scottsdale, AZ - Hybrid
jobs.description:
About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

About the Role

This is an amazing opportunity to use your payroll expertise to reshape our customer experience. You’ll showcase your passion for customer support by resolving tax notices while delivering a world-class customer experience. You'll act as a detective and problem-solver discovering payroll discrepancies, researching tax laws, and identifying the root cause of notices. You will be working closely with tax agencies as well as our cross-functional partner teams to reach the best outcomes for our customers and provide feedback on tools that streamline the resolution process and prevent similar issues in the future.

This role is very hands-on, with an emphasis on research and analysis, excellent communication skills, and first-principles problem-solving. A strong work ethic and desire to be part of the team is critical for success, as well as the ability to retain and apply large amounts of critical information. You must also possess and take pride in high attention to detail, organization, and task management, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven business environment.

About the Team

The Tax Resolution team is within the Payroll, Tax & Compliance Services (PTCS) organization and is at the core of providing services that give our customers peace of mind. Tax Resolution exists to ensure impeccable delivery of key customer needs. There are thousands of critical operational tasks that are completed for our customers accurately and on time, every time, in a proactive and scalable manner. We collaborate, help each other, and work cross-functional in a positive environment.

Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day:

• Provide exceptional service to our customers.

• Interact professionally with our customers via email and/or phone, simplifying the tax notice experience for our customers.

• Research and resolve payroll tax notices on behalf of our customers with guidance from more experienced team members.

• Provide clear and concise case documentation.

• Collaborate with our Compliance, Engagement, and Tax Operations teams.

• Communicate with government agencies to represent Gusto and advocate for our customers under supervision.

• Manage your time effectively to meet set goals.

• Actively use current AI tools in workplace applications

• Handle a queue of tax notices daily, including updating cases as needed, informing customers of any changes, and seeking assistance from peers on escalated issues.

• Participate in team meetings and provide support to fellow TaxRes Advocates.

Here’s what we're looking for:

• 2-4 years of payroll experience, notice resolution experience is a plus.

• Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

• AI Fluency: Capable of using current AI tools and have a mindset to help create and shape new AI tool functionality.

• Capability to manage multiple priorities within a high-volume, fast-paced environment and adapt to shifting priorities daily.

• Commitment to personal high standards and a desire to contribute to team and company goals.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with guidance to resolve issues from complex variables.

• Team player who enjoys collaborating and contributing to team success.

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to simplify complex topics.

• Highly organized and proactive in improving processes.

• Dedicated to providing an exceptional customer experience during key moments in our customers' journey.

Our cash compensation range for this role is $23.50/hr to $25.46/hr for Denver and $21.80-$24.52 for Phoenix and most remote locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

At Gusto, we don't use titles the traditional way, as a signal of rank or hierarchy. Instead, our titles describe two things at once — your craft (what you do, e.g. Engineering, Design) and your scope of ownership (what you're accountable for) — which is why you'll see something like "Head of X" instead of a rank word like "Director" that tells you neither. Because of this, the title on this posting may look different from what you'd expect based on the scope and seniority of the role, and from how similar roles are typically titled elsewhere. If you have questions about how this role compares to your current title or level, your recruiter can help translate.

Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.

Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.

When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.

Reliable, consistent presence: We expect regular and predictable attendance, whether you're working in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, so that you stay closely connected to your team, customers, and stakeholders in real time and ensure colleagues and customers receive the timely support and responsiveness they deserve.

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you.

Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer.

Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Community Engagement Manager, Data Centers (Indiana & Kentucky)
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Indiana and Kentucky to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.

You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.

You will travel regularly within Indiana and Kentucky, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

Key responsibilities

• Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with county commissioners and councils, Kentucky fiscal courts and judge-executives, mayors and city councils, plan commissions and zoning boards, state and regional economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the Indiana and Kentucky data center markets you cover

• Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations

• Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate

• Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media

• Monitor community sentiment and local political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement

• Partner with the Real Estate and Infrastructure team to bring community input into how projects are planned, communicated, and delivered, not just how they are announced

• Work with the Communications team to develop proactive, locally relevant messaging

• Coordinate charitable giving, community investment, and economic development commitments in your markets, including managing nonprofit partner relationships

• Partner with the Energy and Sustainability team to explain our approach to environmental stewardship and respond to questions about power, water, and land use, including how large electricity needs are served by local utilities and rural electric cooperatives

• Build a community engagement playbook and repeatable processes that scale as Anthropic's infrastructure footprint grows

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in community affairs, public affairs, economic development, government relations, local or state government, or a closely related field

• Direct experience working for or engaging with county and municipal governments and a broad set of community stakeholders on behalf of large infrastructure, construction, energy, or technology projects, with a working understanding of how local politics and community dynamics actually play out

• A skilled relationship and coalition builder who earns trust with a diverse group of stakeholders, and who maintains relationships through difficult conversations

• The ability to represent a company credibly in public settings, including town halls, hearings, and press interviews

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn a complex operational plan into plain language that a local official or reporter can understand and respond to

• The ability to work independently, get up to speed quickly on complex policy issues, and manage multiple concurrent engagements across different markets without losing track of any of them

• Based in Indiana or Kentucky or willing to relocate to one of them, and prepared to travel regularly across both states

Preferred qualifications

• 7+ years of experience in community engagement specifically on data center, utility, energy, or large-scale industrial infrastructure projects, or in local government

• Familiarity with land use, zoning, and permitting processes at the county and municipal level in Indiana and/or Kentucky, including local tax abatement and incentive approvals

• Experience managing corporate social responsibility programs

• Established relationships with economic development, workforce, or civic organizations in the markets this role covers

• Experience working with real estate, legal, communications, and policy teams at the same time

• A genuine interest in the communities where you work, not just the projects you are managing

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$265,000—$295,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
Provide services and support as a Construction/Industrial Hygiene Functional Area Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional (USFCO109USFIH104) under Labor Category: Health and Safety Specialist at Savannah River Site / Aiken, South Carolina.  Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional - Construction/Industrial Hygiene (USFCO109USFIH104) works collaboratively as part of the ProSidian Engagement Team as Exempt [1099] personnel.

Location: SRMC SDU-11 | Tentative Start Date: 11/9/26 | Schedule: 5/10's | Estimated Duration: ~ 6 months  Contract

This is a Labor Hour Subcontract or Contract W-2 (IRS-1099) Position, and ProSidian reserves the right to convert to a Full-Time ProSidian employed W-2 Position.  The role(s) are located at Savannah River Site / Aiken, South Carolina with identified Work Site Address (121 Richland Ave E, Aiken, SC 29801, USA), providing Construction/Industrial Hygiene functions working to provide BOA Support Services for multiple department requirement Service Areas (SA) for Savannah River Remediation LLC (The SRMC/LW Contractor) at the U.S. Department of Energy | Savannah River Site (DOE-SRS) in Aiken, SC to support the evolving needs of the organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional - Construction/Industrial Hygiene (USFCO109USFIH104)

Serve as a Certified Industrial Hygienist supporting worker health protection and safe project execution within a Department of Energy/Savannah River Mission Completion (DOE/SRMC) Nuclear-Site Environment. The professional will develop and oversee industrial hygiene monitoring plans, exposure-control strategies, air-monitoring activities, respiratory-protection support, and associated compliance documentation. The position reports to the Certified Safety Professional / Site Project Manager and coordinates functionally with the Corporate Safety Director.

The Certified Industrial Hygiene (CIH) Technician / Safety Professional will provide on-site occupational health and construction safety support as a ProSidian Engagement Team Member supporting US Fusion and Specialty Construction | US Rubber and Specialty Applications at the U.S. Department of Energy’s Savannah River Site near Aiken, South Carolina.

The position primarily supports anticipating, recognizing, evaluating, documenting, and controlling workplace health hazards. The technician will also perform assigned safety-professional duties involving field inspections, hazard-analysis reviews, pre-job planning, worker observations, corrective-action tracking, and compliance support. Activities requiring independent CIH or CSP professional judgment will be performed by, or under the direction of, an appropriately credentialed professional.

Primary Deliverable Responsibility / Task Listing:

• Develop IH Monitoring Plan And Records Structure - Primary Tool / Record: IH Plan / SharePoint => One-Time: X | Daily: - | Weekly: - | Monthly: - | As Needed: N/A
• Identify Work Activities Requiring IH Monitoring Or Respiratory Controls - Primary Tool / Record: Safety / IH Log => One-Time: - | Daily: X | Weekly: X | Monthly: - | As Needed: N/A
• Review Sampling Data And Exposure Trends - Primary Tool / Record: IH Monitoring Records => One-Time: - | Daily: X | Weekly: - | Monthly: - | As Needed: X
• Coordinate IH Tech Daily Sampling And Records Completion - Primary Tool / Record: IH Log / Teams => One-Time: - | Daily: X | Weekly: - | Monthly: - | As Needed: N/A
• Communicate IH Findings And Required Controls To Safety/Project Leadership - Primary Tool / Record: Teams / Meeting Notes => One-Time: - | Daily: X | Weekly: - | Monthly: - | As Needed: X
• Review Respiratory Protection Documentation And Related Training Needs - Primary Tool / Record: Training Log / Safety Records => One-Time: - | Daily: - | Weekly: X | Monthly: - | As Needed: X
• Provide Weekly IH Summary To Safety And Project Leadership - Primary Tool / Record: IH Summary / Power BI Input => One-Time: - | Daily: - | Weekly: X | Monthly: - | As Needed: N/A
• Support Incident/Exposure Investigation As Required - Primary Tool / Record: Incident Records / IH Records => One-Time: - | Daily: - | Weekly: - | Monthly: - | As Needed: X
• Prepare Monthly IH Trend Summary - Primary Tool / Record: IH Report / SharePoint => One-Time: - | Daily: - | Weekly: - | Monthly: X | As Needed: N/A

The Certified Industrial Hygienist will establish the project’s industrial hygiene monitoring plan and records structure, identify work activities requiring exposure monitoring or respiratory controls, and coordinate daily sampling and documentation activities with the Industrial Hygienist Technician.

Successful candidates will bring industrial hygiene expertise, disciplined recordkeeping, and the ability to translate monitoring findings into practical exposure-control recommendations. The position requires attention to safety, quality, traceability, and procedural compliance in a nuclear-site environment. Project communications, decisions, and direction must be captured through approved channels and maintained in designated record locations. Escalate safety, quality, nuclear-site access, security, and compliance concerns promptly through the established chain of command.

• Certified Industrial Hygienist Reports To: Certified Safety Professional / Site Project Manager; functional coordination with Corporate Safety Director.
• Certified Industrial Hygienist Role Purpose: Develops and oversees industrial hygiene monitoring plan, exposure control strategy, air monitoring, respiratory protection support, and IH compliance documentation.
• Primary M365 System Responsibilities: Maintains IH monitoring plan, exposure records, sampling summaries, respiratory protection documentation support, and IH dashboard inputs.
• Authority / Decision Rights: Authority to define IH monitoring requirements, recommend exposure controls, require additional sampling or protective measures, and escalate IH risks.

Key Interfaces

• Certified Safety Professional
• Industrial Hygienist Tech
• Safety Reps
• Project Superintendent
• Site Project Manager
• Document Controls

DOE / SRMC / Nuclear Site Considerations

• Maintain strong record discipline because the project operates in a DOE / SRMC environment where traceability, safety, quality, and procedural compliance are critical.
• Ensure project communications, decisions, and direction are captured through approved channels and stored in the appropriate project record location.
• Escalate safety, quality, nuclear-site access, security, or compliance concerns immediately through the defined chain of command.

Desired Education / Experience Requirements / Qualifications For Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional (USFCO109USFIH104) Candidates:

• Education: A bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in industrial hygiene, occupational safety and health, environmental health, engineering, chemistry, biology, physics, public health, or a closely related scientific or technical discipline is preferred. An associate degree, relevant technical credential, or equivalent combination of education, specialized training, and directly applicable experience may be considered when permitted by the governing task order.
• Required experience: Professional experience supporting industrial hygiene and construction-safety activities in commercial, industrial, nuclear, power, chemical, defense, federal, laboratory, or other high-hazard environments. Demonstrated capabilities must include field monitoring, exposure assessment, instrument calibration, data collection, recordkeeping, and verification of exposure controls.
• Preferred project experience: Experience supporting demolition, facility modification, concrete work, mechanical or electrical installation, ventilation systems, protective coatings, specialty applications, process systems, equipment installation, maintenance, testing, or commissioning. Previous DOE, NNSA, Savannah River Site, nuclear-facility, NQA-1, or other high-hazard federal-project experience is strongly preferred.
• Regulatory and hazard knowledge: Working knowledge of applicable provisions of 29 CFR Parts 1910 and 1926, 10 CFR Part 851, DOE requirements, Savannah River Site procedures, and recognized industrial-hygiene practices. Knowledge of chemical, physical, biological, and ergonomic hazards encountered in construction and industrial environments is required.
• Technical interpretation and work planning: Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, Safety Data Sheets, procedures, sampling data, laboratory reports, and regulatory requirements. Experience reviewing Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), Activity Hazard Analyses (AHAs), pre-task plans, permits, and work packages to identify occupational-health and safety hazards and appropriate controls.
• Professional certification: Active Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) certification issued by the Board for Global EHS Credentialing is required when independently performing or approving work reserved for a CIH. Other assigned duties must remain within the individual’s qualifications and authorized scope.
• Training and continuing qualifications: Current OSHA 30-Hour Construction training is preferred and may be required before deployment. Applicable First Aid/CPR/AED, HAZWOPER, respiratory protection, confined space, asbestos, lead, silica, hearing conservation, heat stress, fall protection, and other hazard-specific qualifications are preferred. The employee must complete required General Employee Training, site orientation, project indoctrination, task-specific instruction, and refresher training within prescribed timeframes and maintain required medical qualifications, respiratory-protection eligibility, site-access credentials, and project qualifications throughout the assignment.
• Field performance and communication: Ability to work independently in active field environments while coordinating effectively with multidisciplinary project teams. Requires strong technical-writing, oral communication, training, coaching, facilitation, and conflict-resolution skills.
• Citizenship and site access: U.S. citizenship and the ability to satisfy applicable DOE, SRS, SRNS, client, and ProSidian screening, badging, drug-testing, fitness-for-duty, and site-access requirements.
• Driving requirements: A valid driver’s license is required. Any personal vehicle used for project business must have valid registration and legally required insurance.

Skills Required

Primarily focused on Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) / Safety Professional initiatives and aligned with Program Support activities in the Construction/Industrial Hygiene Functional Area.  Industrial-hygiene exposure assessment and sampling-plan implementation

• Personal, area, task-based, and direct-reading monitoring
• Similar-exposure-group support and exposure-data collection
• Industrial-hygiene instrumentation and calibration
• Sampling-media preparation and chain-of-custody management
• Laboratory-result tracking and exposure-data interpretation
• Chemical-hazard recognition and applied toxicology
• Respiratory-protection and ventilation assessment
• Noise, heat-stress, illumination, and ergonomic evaluation
• Silica, asbestos, lead, welding-fume, solvent, coating, particulate, and hazardous-material monitoring
• Hierarchy-of-controls application and control verification
• Field inspection and worker observation
• JHA/AHA, work-package, procedure, and permit review
• Incident fact-finding and corrective-action tracking
• Technical documentation and records management
• Hazard-specific training and field communication
• Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint
• Electronic EHS, document-control, and reporting systems

Required Competencies:

• Worker health and safety commitment
• Technical credibility
• Risk-based judgment
• Field awareness and engagement
• Attention to detail
• Data integrity and documentation discipline
• Practical problem-solving
• Clear technical communication

• We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

• We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.

The Position:

The Medical Director is responsible for establishing and implementing the medical affairs strategy for the Afirma/endocrinology franchise to advance the company’s related genomic into clinical practice.

The Medical Director’s responsibilities will align along four focused areas:

(1). Key Opinion Leader (KOL) relationship development;

(2.) Publication strategy and execution that support product adoption and reimbursement;

(3.) Scientific support of the commercial team; and (4.) scientific leadership of R&D and clinical trial strategy and execution.

Responsibilities:

Provide strategic and tactical guidance across the indication/products:

• Initiate, cultivate and manage relationships with key global opinion leaders to foster a collaborative synergy between Veracyte and academia including but not limited to the following avenues: Medical Advisory Board Meetings Presentations at national and international meetings Peer reviewed publications Investigator initiated research Guideline inclusion Medical policy inclusion Engagement in clinical trials

Provide leadership in the development and execution of Veracyte’s publication plan:

• Lead the development of Veracyte’s publication plan

• Collaborate internally and externally to optimize presentations

• Innovate key message communication to a variety of stakeholders

Participate in Veracyte’s Product Development teams for the development of future products and guidance to all features of tests under development.

• Provide input during product concept, feasibility, development, validation, and through to product launch.

• Develop the technology differentiators that help establish product superiority

• Represent the voice of customer for product design; help to finalize customer requirements so that products will be competitive on market.

• Plan and design clinical trials including consideration for sample collection during post-launch validation trials, clinical utility trials, and cost effectiveness studies.

Other Responsibilities:

• Remain knowledgeable and conversant about new developments and trends in thyroid endocrinology that impact or influence our product portfolio.

• Provide leadership and contributions to the commercial team in areas including but not limited to: Global marketing and sales Payer relations Medical policy Veracyte team education

Proven ability to successfully communicate, consult, collaborate and coach in a complex and competitive environment. Ability to translate complex medical messages into communications that are understood by each target audience. Ability to distill large complex clinical data sets into meaningful and understandable messages.

• Warm, engaging personality with highly developed influencing skills and ability to represent the Company and its products/services with credibility.

• Strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work cross-functionally throughout the Company.

• Collaborative and strong leadership qualities; ability to build team consensus.

• The ability to leverage business principles within the team while maintaining a corporate view of the portfolio.

• Ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial, dynamic and fast-paced environment.

• Exceptional communicator, including both written and verbal skills, with ability to clearly and thoroughly communicate on behalf of all Company matters.

• Impeccable ethics, conducting business in the most professional manner possible.

jobs.description:
ABOUT SAVVY WEALTH:

Wealth management is a $545 billion industry that still runs on manual work. 75% of advisors offer no digital communication beyond email, and most still build financial plans by hand in Excel. Savvy is reinventing what it looks like to be a financial advisor. Founder Ritik Malhotra saw the fragmentation firsthand after seeking out his own advisor, and started Savvy to give independent advisors a modern, AI-native home.



Savvy is a registered investment advisor (RIA), and we partner with experienced financial advisors who want to grow without running the back office themselves. Advisors bring their book and join Savvy, running under their own brand (or ours), and Savvy earns a percentage of the assets they manage. In return, they get a true business-in-a-box: a proprietary tech platform and client portal, an in-house marketing team that helps them grow, a world-class investment management team, and a dedicated client services team that runs day-to-day operations and support. Advisors at Savvy service up to 50% more households and save 19 hours a week.



AI runs through everything we do. On the product side, Savvy Intelligence (released April 2026) is the only AI built for wealth managers that can see a client's complete financial picture. Internally, everyone at Savvy uses Claude and is encouraged to experiment with it, backed by a dedicated AI enablement team and a RevOps org building agents in-house.



The trajectory is steep and it's still early. We're a Series C company with 170+ people, $200M raised, and $100M ARR in sight this year. Inc. ranked us the No. 1 fastest-growing financial services company in America in 2026. Come build the next stage with us!



Recognition:

We're a Certified Great Place to Work and have been honored for our culture and our growth:

Hi! I’m Lauren & I lead Talent at Savvy. I’m hiring someone to join my team and wanted to share a little about what I’m looking for and what you can expect from us.

I’m looking for someone who’s motivated to keep getting better, curious enough to ask one more question, and resourceful enough to try a different approach when something isn’t working. We celebrate wins big & small, and recognizing each other’s work is part of our DNA.

You’ll work alongside incredibly talented people who are generous with what they know, open to new ideas, and excited to help each other succeed.

My hope is that you’ll look back on this role and be proud of the people you hired, how much you learned, and what we all built together.

If that sounds like the kind of team you want to be part of, I’d love to meet you.

Lauren

We’re hiring a Senior Talent Partner to help build teams across Savvy. You’ll own searches from intake through close starting with GTM, Operations, and G&A with room to expand into other parts of the business as we grow. 

You’ll learn what makes each team successful, develop a perspective on the talent market, and help our leaders make thoughtful hiring decisions. You’ll also have room to experiment, build with AI, and improve how we recruit. We’re looking for someone who’s excited by that mix of ownership, learning, and building.

Own Your Searches

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Group Reservations Management

• Manage and maintain all assigned group and tour room blocks in accordance with contracted agreements, booking recaps, and amendments.
• Monitor pick-up, cut-off dates, attrition, and block utilization to ensure inventory accuracy and optimal revenue performance.
• Coordinate room block adjustments with Sales and Revenue Management based on forecasted demand, contracted commitments, and group requirements.
• Maintain awareness of high-demand periods, sell-out dates, and room category availability.
• Coordinate pre-blocking of specialty accommodations, including suites, connecting rooms, accessible rooms, and VIP accommodations.
• Assist with cut-off date management and release of unused inventory.
• Communicate inventory concerns and group-related issues proactively to Reservations, Revenue Management, Front Office, and Sales teams.

Group Reservations Administration

• Review and interpret group contracts to ensure reservation setup aligns with contractual terms and conditions.
• Establish and maintain accurate group headers, rate codes, package inclusions, billing instructions, and reservation details within the property management system.
• Enter rooming lists accurately and efficiently while ensuring all special requests, room categories, rates, and package components are properly recorded.
• Create and maintain master accounts and group billing arrangements according to contracted requirements.
• Audit group reservations regularly to ensure accuracy and compliance with established procedures.

Client & Internal Communication

• Serve as the primary reservations contact for assigned groups from contract turnover through departure.
• Communicate professionally with meeting planners, travel partners, and group contacts regarding rooming lists, reservation status, room block utilization, and special accommodations.
• Partner closely with Sales Managers to fully understand client expectations and contract obligations.
• Participate in group meetings, forecasting discussions, and operational reviews as required.
• Provide timely responses to inquiries from guests, clients, and internal departments.

Revenue Optimization

• Support revenue management strategies by ensuring group inventory is managed according to established guidelines.
• Identify opportunities to maximize room revenue through inventory management, rate integrity, and upselling when appropriate.
• Monitor reservation trends and provide recommendations regarding block adjustments and availability controls.
• Assist in balancing group commitments with transient demand to optimize occupancy and profitability.

Guest Profile & Loyalty Management

• Maintain accurate guest records within Opera, ALICE, ACDC, Kipsu, and other hotel systems.
• Update guest profiles, preferences, stay history, and special requests.
• Support the Accor Live Limitless (ALL) loyalty program through enrollment, member recognition, profile management, and redemption support.
• Ensure VIPs, ALL members, repeat guests, and special celebrations receive appropriate recognition and amenities.

Service Recovery & Problem Resolution

• Take ownership of guest concerns from initial contact through resolution.
• Handle guest complaints with professionalism, empathy, urgency, and discretion.
• Coordinate recovery efforts and guest satisfaction initiatives.
• Escalate issues to leadership when appropriate.
• Document concerns, actions taken, and outcomes accurately.

Your experience and skills include:

• Previous experience in hotel reservations, front office, sales, or group housing preferred.
• Experience in a luxury hotel or resort environment strongly preferred.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.
• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office and hotel reservation systems (Opera preferred).
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Education & Experience:

• High School Diploma or GED required.
• Associate's or Bachelor's Degree in Hospitality Management, Business, or related field preferred.
• Minimum one (1) year of luxury hospitality, guest services, concierge, reservations, or customer service experience preferred.
• Previous experience with luxury resorts, or LQA environments preferred.
