jobs.title: Vice President, Investor Relations
jobs.description:
At d-Matrix, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of respect and collaboration.

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our team is inclusive, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution.  Ready to come find your playground? Together, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. 



Role Overview

d-Matrix is a fast-growing, venture-backed AI inference semiconductor company. Our Corsair inference accelerator is built on Memory Centric Compute and paired with JetStream networking and Aviator software. Our next-generation Raptor platform uses 3D In-Memory Compute (3DIMC) to stack compute directly on DRAM and break the memory wall in AI inference. As our first VP of Investor Relations, you will build the IR function from the ground up and own how our technology, roadmap, and financial trajectory are explained to existing shareholders, prospective investors, and sell-side analysts as we prepare for the public markets. You will partner directly with the CEO, CFO, and executive team, and serve as the bridge between our engineers and the investment community. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco or New York, with travel to our Santa Clara HQ and worldwide for investor and PR events as needed.

What You Will Do

 - Define and execute a multi-year IR strategy aligned with corporate strategy, financing milestones, and the path to becoming a public company.

 - Own the d-Matrix equity story, including the shift from training to inference, the memory wall, how Memory Centric Compute and 3DIMC compare with GPUs, HBM-based systems, and custom ASICs, and the Corsair-to-Raptor roadmap.

 - Serve as the primary contact for existing shareholders and for prospective venture, growth, crossover, strategic, sovereign, and public-market investors, and build the investor pipeline and CRM.

 - Partner with the CEO, CFO, and Corporate Development on capital raises, including investor outreach, data room management, diligence responses, and coordination with banks and placement agents.

 - Author investor presentations, shareholder updates, executive scripts, and Q&A frameworks that translate technical milestones into clear investor messages, and maintain a single source of truth for key metrics and KPIs.

 - Build relationships with sell-side analysts and industry researchers, track public comparables and investor sentiment, and brief leadership and the Board on shareholder composition, market feedback, and peer activity.

 - Build IR infrastructure for a future IPO, including disclosure policy, Regulation FD protocols, quiet period guidelines, earnings scripts, mock earnings cycles, and the IR website, in partnership with Finance, Legal, and outside counsel.

 - Manage disclosure and confidentiality, align investor messaging with Marketing, Communications, Sales, and Legal, prepare executives for investor meetings and conferences, and hire and manage IR team members and external vendors.

What You Will Bring

 - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

 - 8+ years of progressive experience in investor relations, equity research, buy-side investing, investment banking, or corporate and strategic finance, focused on AI hardware, semiconductors, or AI infrastructure software.

 - Working knowledge of the AI ecosystem, including training vs. inference, GPUs, custom silicon, high bandwidth memory, networking, and hyperscaler spending.

 - Established relationships with growth, crossover, and public-market investors, sell-side analysts, and investment banks.

 - Working knowledge of Regulation FD, SEC disclosure requirements, and the IPO process and roadshow.

 - Excellent financial modeling, valuation, writing, and presentation skills.

 - Experience building a function and team from scratch, with the judgment, independence, and integrity to handle material non-public information and work across Finance, Technology, and Business. Willingness to travel for investor meetings, conferences, and roadshows.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Deep technical fluency in AI inference and memory technology, with the ability to explain concepts such as memory bandwidth, energy per token, and 3D stacking credibly to a financial audience.

jobs.title: Part Time Floor Leader - UTC Sarasota
jobs.description:
Position: Part Time Floor Leader

Weekly: 20-29 hours

Interview Plan

Floor Leader

As a Floor Leader, you'll play a vital role in supporting the Store Management Team across all areas of the business. This includes everything from driving sales and opening/closing the store to analyzing sales results and leading training sessions. Together with your fellow leaders, you'll work to ensure that every aspect of the store is firing on all cylinders, creating an exceptional customer experience, a happy and motivated staff, and operational excellence that would make even the most detail-oriented among us proud.

Your day-to-day will be spent on the shop floor, where you'll lead and inspire a team of sales associates to achieve and surpass their goals. By fostering a culture of passion and positivity, you'll help create a work environment that's both productive and fun, resulting in happy customers and happy employees. The Floor Leader role is all about making the world a better place one soap at a time!

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer Experience:

• Driving Sales: Utilize the StoreForce dashboard results to provide effective coaching and feedback to the sales team, and make necessary adjustments to the shop floor structure to meet and exceed sales goals. Take ownership for your results and actively work to grow the contribution of your segments to the store’s overall sales. Celebrate sales achievements with your team!

• Customer Experience: Lead by example in delivering a world-class customer experience on the shop floor, including product demonstrations. Observe and listen to consultations, collaborate with your team, and strive to exceed daily sales goals. By fostering a culture of excellence in customer service, you'll drive sales, create a loyal customer base, and build a positive reputation for your store.

• Building the Brand: Educate customers on Lush brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement, hosting store parties, and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed product recommendations for every need.

Team Involvement:

• Development: Train and coach Sales Ambassadors and peers on effective sales techniques and product knowledge to improve their performance, support the growth of your team, and to increase sales. Lead by example, take ownership of your development, assess your performance, and actively seek feedback, resources, and opportunities to improve and elevate your skills, knowledge and abilities.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: Encourage open communication and actively listen to team members perspectives related to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB). Foster a sense of belonging by promoting teamwork, encouraging collaboration, and recognizing and valuing each employee's unique contributions.

Operational Excellence:

• Cash Handling and Store Opening/Closing: Manage cash handling, including customer transactions, opening/closing the register, reconciling cash drawers, preparing nightly deposits, and securing the store at the end of each day. As required at your store location, take deposits to the bank.

• Time and Attendance: Lead by example in terms of attendance and punctuality, and encourage the same from all employees. Monitor employee breaks to ensure they are taking their scheduled breaks, promoting a healthy work environment and improving employee wellbeing. Review daily communications, including store updates and task lists, to ensure that team members are informed and prepared for their shifts, promoting a culture of preparedness and organization.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store to enhance the customer's shopping experience and drive sales.

• Stock and Inventory: Train your team on inventory best practices and fresh standards, and support management with inventory tasks. Utilize Visual Merchandising guidelines to make real-time adjustments to product displays based on sales and improve the customer experience.

• Policies and Procedures: Support your management team to keep your store compliant and ensure your staff are practicing company standards for opening and closing, product integrity, respectful workplace, and health and safety.

Qualifications:

Required:

• Minimum 1 year of experience in:

• customer service and sales

• cash handling and opening/closing procedures

• supervisory experience involving coaching, feedback, and training

• problem-solving issues related to customer service in day-to-day operations

• a fast-paced team environment

• Knowledge and passion for skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Flexible schedule to accommodate store needs, including evenings, weekends, and holidays

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Experience analyzing sales metrics

• Experience working in skincare or cosmetics

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French or other languages

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

LinkedIn

jobs.title: Manager, Program (ELA/Special Education Coaching)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE
Teaching Lab is a nonprofit organization with a mission to fundamentally shift the paradigm of teacher professional learning. We envision a world where teachers and students thrive together in communities that enable life-long learning and meaningful lives. In partnership with teachers, we transform professional learning from the ground up to dramatically improve student outcomes. We also work with school, district, and state leaders to create the instructional systems necessary to support these changes. To learn more about Teaching Lab, explore our website at www.teachinglab.org.

OUR VALUES
Teaching Lab seeks to fundamentally shift the paradigm of teacher professional learning in pursuit of excellent educational outcomes for every child.

Teaching Lab’s ultimate goals are:

• Educators learn more than they would without us

• Students learn more than they would without us, in a way that cannot be predicted by race, gender, or family income

• Educators we serve say they love our approach, and they want to keep doing it to advance educational equity

All employees are expected to embrace Teaching Lab’s Values to help us achieve our ultimate goals.

• Collaboration & Responsive Service

• Resilient Solution-Finding

• Research & Learning With Humility

• Accountable Excellence

• Equity & Justice

Read more about Teaching Lab’s Values here.

Type of Vacancy: Salaried (Full-Time)
Start Date: November-December 2026
Location: New York, NY
Reports To: Senior Manager, Program or Director, Program
Supervises: None
Travel: On-site with some remote work
Compensation: $80,000 to $105,529
Areas of Expertise: Teacher Coaching: Improving student outcomes by engaging in coaching inquiry cycles with teachers. Instructional Design: Designing and facilitating effective and engaging professional learning experiences that build educator capacity to support students with disabilities in literacy instruction. Instructional Expertise: Deep knowledge of K-8 ELA special education, including a strong understanding of specially designed instruction, IEP-aligned accommodations and modifications, inclusive practices, and high-quality instructional materials.

ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT
The Program department’s primary purpose is to design, deliver, and continuously improve teacher professional learning programs that strengthen instructional practice and drive student achievement. The team’s main functions include managing and implementing scopes of work with partners, providing coaching and professional learning for teachers and leaders, and creating research-based content and learning assets tailored to partner needs. The Program department contributes to Teaching Lab’s mission by ensuring that every partnership drives measurable impact on teacher practice and student learning, advancing educational equity at scale.

ABOUT THE ROLE
The Program Manager’s primary responsibility is to implement excellent programmatic services through coaching, facilitation of professional learning, and collaboration with school and district leaders. Along with Program team members, project leads, and organizational partners, the Program Manager will also hold responsibilities in the following areas:

• Engaging in coaching cycles, including observations, modeling, co-teaching, data analysis, and feedback

• Designing and facilitating high-quality professional learning content and resources grounded in research-based instructional practices

• Maintaining strong partner relationships, supporting contract renewals, and contributing to business development as needed

• Supporting Teaching Lab systems, tools, and processes for scaling partnerships, monitoring impact, and ensuring effective implementation

The Program Manager role is an individual contributor-level position with no management responsibilities. This role is essential to ensuring the effective delivery of programmatic goals, high-quality coaching and professional learning, and sustained impact on teacher and student learning. Success in this position requires strong collaboration, organizational skills, adaptability, and a commitment to improving educational outcomes.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS
Education, Work Experience, and Knowledge

• Bachelor's degree

• Five (5) or more years combined experience working in K-8 education, with a minimum of two years experience teaching K-8 students from traditionally underserved backgrounds with demonstrated evidence of impact

• Two (2) or more years combined experience working with partners outside of their organization to manage workflow or deliver services

• Two (2) or more years of combined experience planning and implementing projects

• Two (2) or more years combined experience leading or coaching the implementation of HQIM (in any subject area)

• Deep knowledge and experience with College- and Career-Ready math or ELA content and practice standards

• Experience designing impactful professional learning for educators

• Experience facilitating impactful professional learning or coaching for educators

• Experience managing relationships with clients and stakeholders in an education context

• Experience teaching or coaching at least one of the following curricula: HMH Into Reading, HMH Into Literature, EL Education, S.P.I.R.E. Foundations, Aprendo Leyendo, Wilson, Phonics For Reading, REWARDS/REWARDS Plus, STARI

Values, Skills, and Competencies

• Strong commitment to growth mindset for both adults and students, with a desire to continuously strengthen instructional practices and team capabilities

• Ability to design and deliver high-quality, evidence-based professional learning that advances teaching and learning outcomes

• Compelling communication and facilitation skills that build engagement and influence across diverse educators and stakeholders

• Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage complex projects, multiple priorities, and tight timelines in a fast-paced environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Advanced degree

• Deep understanding of the specified curriculum, including its design and component parts

• Experience providing professional learning support and services in and for consultative organizations

STRATEGIC OBJECTIVES AND KEY SUCCESS INDICATORS (KSIs)
All team members are accountable for achieving goals set in collaboration with their Home Manager, which are aligned with Teaching Lab’s annual goals, department goals, and Home Manager goals, as applicable.

Within the role, model the radical commitments for our values.

WORKING CONDITIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

• All team members must be able to work a flexible schedule to support operational needs.

• All team members must be able to perform the essential project, duties, and responsibilities with or without accommodation.

• All team members are expected to support program/project needs, which could mean that you hold multiple roles on project teams (i.e., Project Lead, Project Sponsor, Coach Developer, Client Partnership Manager, Instructional Designer, Subject Matter Expert, Coach/Facilitator, Project Management Support, or Analyst).

• Travel could be required for the role. Travel is determined based on business needs and can vary depending on partnership/contract requirements.

• All roles at Teaching Lab are contingent upon the availability of project work, available funding, and organizational priorities.

• Ability to work effectively in a remote environment, including extended periods of sitting, frequent participation in virtual meetings and video calls, and consistent use of computer-based systems and communication tools.

• Teaching Lab encourages practices that support employee wellness, including regular breaks, ergonomic workspace setup, and resources to support health and balance while working remotely.

ABOUT FULL-TIME ROLES
At Teaching Lab, our full-time team members are the heart of our mission to advance educational equity. Joining us in a staff role means being part of a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your contributions shape the organization’s growth and impact every day. You’ll work cross-functionally with colleagues who share a deep commitment to excellence, equity, and innovation, and you’ll have opportunities to both lead and learn as we tackle ambitious goals together.

As a full-time employee, you’ll also benefit from Teaching Lab’s competitive package designed to support your health, financial security, and professional growth. Our offerings include organizational contributions toward medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with employer match, and additional support for technology and home office expenses. Employees enjoy generous paid time off, funding for their professional development or well-being, and dedicated holidays that prioritize rest and renewal.

Full-time roles at Teaching Lab combine mission-driven purpose with comprehensive support, offering you the stability and resources to thrive while making a lasting impact in the field of education.

TRAVEL
On-site with some remote work.

COMPENSATION
The full salary range for this position is $80,000 - $121,007 annually. This range represents the full earning potential for the role, including opportunities for salary growth over time based on performance, tenure, and organizational budget. The anticipated hiring range for this position is $80,000 - $105,529. Teaching Lab will generally cap salaries for new employees at 105% of the midpoint of the full salary range ($105,529) to allow for continued growth in the role over time.There are two types of experience being considered for this role: Experience that is directly relevant to the role and Total Working Experience, in all fields. This includes: internships and consulting work. In collaboration with the hiring manager, the People and Culture team calculates experience based on the candidate’s most current resume. When calculating the offer, consideration is given to candidates that possess additional qualifications (i.e., desired qualifications). Teaching Lab will generally cap salaries for new employees at 105% of the midpoint to allow for continued growth in the role over time.

CLOSING/REVIEW DATE
This position opened on October 17, 2026 and will remain open until filled. All applications received between October 17, 2026 and October 27, 2026 will be reviewed by the hiring team. Applications received after October 27, 2026 will be reviewed as needed.

APPLICATION TERMS AND CONDITIONS

I understand that this Employment Application is not an offer of employment. If employed, employment is at will, and either party can terminate the employment relationship at any time.

I understand that if I am offered a conditional offer of employment, it would be contingent upon successful pre-work checks, which include references and verifications/checks for a social security number, education, employment, criminal records searches (national and county), global watch list, and sex offender status. jobs.title: Logistics Material Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE LOGISTICS TEAM

 

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 

 - Run commercial storage across a growing site footprint. Space has to be found, secured, and managed ahead of every build, and you'll shape how a fast-multiplying network of sites gets stored and stocked.

 - Deliver every material on time and in full while everything around us changes. Sites, schedules, and demand keep shifting, and one late delivery can stall a build measured in gigawatts.

 - Run logistics faster and with fewer resources than anyone in the industry. We hold the team to a bar no logistics operation has met at this scale, so every process gets rebuilt until it's the fastest and leanest there is.


ROLE SCOPE

 - Run auto-replenishment and min/max levels for data center ops consumables across every site, so ops crews never wait on supplies.

 - Buy the equipment and consumables to set up each new site, with everything on hand before go-live as sites come online in pieces.

 - Negotiate pricing, payment terms, lead times, and service levels with vendors, and set a vendor strategy site by site that balances cost, local availability, and continuity of supply.

 - Work with Data Center Operations, inventory control, warehousing, and finance to turn consumption data and build schedules into forecasts and purchase plans.

 - Build the buying playbook for ops spend: standard catalogs, preferred vendors, and ordering thresholds that every new site adopts from day one.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 

 - You've owned min/max levels and replenishment for consumables across multiple sites or a high-volume operation, and you tracked stock-outs and overstock as numbers you drove down.

 - You've negotiated terms with vendors on price tiers, payment terms, lead times, and service levels, and you can point to what you saved or secured.

 - You've decided where to consolidate spend with a national supplier and where a local vendor serves a site better, and you managed those vendors to performance.

 - You've bought for a new facility or site launch against a schedule you didn't control, and everything was there on opening day.

 - You work across operations, warehousing, finance, and engineering, and the teams you support call you first when they need something fast.

 - You make purchasing decisions from data: consumption history, lead times, and vendor performance drive your orders, and your records stay clean enough for anyone to audit.

 - Bonus: Data center or critical facilities operations. Auto-replenishment and vendor-managed inventory programs. Procurement and ERP platforms (Zip, NetSuite). Spend analytics and category management.
   
    


SALARY & BENEFITS

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.
   
   - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.
     
     
     Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer,  Mobile

Our platform is fully integrated with central clearing houses and exchanges to support billions in trading volume per day. By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we're building the essentials to compete in today's fast-paced markets.

The Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Clear Street Frontend team, you’ll help architect and build the next generation of Clear Street Active, our high-performance trading platform tailored for active traders. The platform integrates real-time market data, low-latency execution workflows, and advanced trading tools into a performant, responsive web interface. You’ll collaborate with a cross-functional team on large-scale initiatives that deliver high-impact solutions and shape the future of our prime brokerage experience.

The Team:

Our engineers take pride not just in the value we provide our customers but also in the quality of our work. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Clear Street is modernizing the brokerage ecosystem. Founded in 2018, Clear Street is a diversified financial services firm replacing the legacy infrastructure used across capital markets.

We started from scratch by building a completely cloud-native clearing and custody system designed for today's complex, global market. Our platform is fully integrated with central clearing houses and exchanges to support billions in trading volume per day. We've agonized about our data model abstractions, created horizontal scalability, and crafted thoughtful APIs. All so we can provide a best-in-class experience for our clients.

By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we're building the essentials to compete in today's fast-paced markets.

The Team:

The mission of the Clear Street Active team is to provide best execution for every asset class in every market. Active is building a new, state-of-the-art, cloud-based trading platform giving high-performance traders access to liquidity venues across multiple asset classes, cutting-edge charting, and sophisticated order handling.

The Active Data team owns how the business understands itself, and increasingly how it decides what to do next. Data flows into our warehouse from ad platforms, product analytics, CRM and support systems, and the brokerage's own systems. It flows back out to the platforms that message our customers, bid for new ones, and manage relationships with them. Every hop is a place where data can be duplicated, delayed, or quietly redefined, and an error that leaves the warehouse does not stay a reporting problem. It spends ad budget on the wrong people, sends a customer the wrong message, or misstates a regulated number. Moving data is table stakes. Keeping it true as it travels is the problem this role owns. It is a small team with a wide surface area, and we are scaling it as the platform grows toward tens of thousands of accounts.

The Role:

Three areas of the business depend on this role, and you will own the data for all of them:

• Growth. Bring in spend, clicks, and conversions from every paid, affiliate, and organic channel, reconcile them against our own records, and send funded-account outcomes back to the ad platforms, so bidding optimizes for customers who actually fund and trade.

• Lifecycle and the user journey. Resolve each customer's identity from a first anonymous visit through sign-up, KYC, funding, and first trade, and keep lifecycle messaging, CRM, and support systems in step with what actually happened.

• Brokerage data. Model account opening, KYC, funding and transfers, and trading from the platform's own systems, with the precision a regulated broker-dealer needs.

Across all three, you will:

• Own data integrity in both directions. Prove that every feed arrived complete and on time, and that every outbound sync landed what it should. A duplicated conversion inflates ad spend, a stale attribute sends the wrong message, and a broken join misstates funded accounts to leadership.

• Own the warehouse layers in dbt: raw landing, staged and identity-resolved models, and the curated models that analysts, data scientists, dashboards, and internal AI agents read from. Every model has a declared grain and tests.

• Establish data contracts with product engineering and with the owners of the platforms we depend on, so an upstream change is caught at the boundary instead of silently nulling a field three models downstream. You will define these rather than inherit them.

• Own governance: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and auditability, including self-serve tools that do not become a way around permissions.

• Choose deliberately between batch, change-data-capture, and streaming, based on what each consumer actually needs.

• Partner with Marketing, Product, and Operations to get the events and fields the business needs captured. This role is measured on whether the business's numbers are right and on time, not on pipelines delivered.

What We Value:

• Engineers measured on whether the numbers are right, not on what was shipped

• Very high agency. Much of the work here begins before the requirement is clear: the source has no documentation, the field you need was never captured, and the team that owns it is busy shipping. We need someone who chases a dependency into another team and ships something reliable without a spec.

• Skepticism about data, including your own pipelines. Check grain, joins, and completeness before you trust a number.

• A preference for boring, observable systems over clever ones

• Clear communication with non-engineers: able to explain to a marketer why yesterday's number moved, and to negotiate a schema change with a product team the same afternoon

• Pragmatism: ship the version that works now, and improve it deliberately rather than waiting for the ideal one

Requirements:

• Minimum five years in data engineering or analytics engineering, with production pipelines you were on the hook for when they broke

• Deep proficiency in SQL and Python, and production experience with dbt in a layered warehouse: raw, staged, and curated models with a declared grain, tests, and incremental builds

• Hands-on experience bringing in third-party and application data through managed connectors, event pipelines, and change-data-capture, and handling what goes wrong with each: schema drift, resyncs, duplicates, and late or missing records

• Experience sending data back out, through reverse ETL, audiences, or conversion feeds, and owning its correctness after it leaves the warehouse

• Data quality in practice: reconciliation against systems of record, freshness and volume monitoring, and the fix that stops an incident from recurring

• Data governance in practice: role-based access, PII masking, retention, and an audit trail you could show a regulator

• Familiarity with fintech or brokerage data: account opening and KYC, funding and transfers, trades and settlement, and why superficially similar balance or status fields are not interchangeable

• Self-starter who operates well without a large team to escalate into

Nice To Haves:

• Identity resolution across web, app, and account data: anonymous visitors, multiple devices, and more than one account per person

• Marketing data: ad-platform APIs, conversion APIs, click IDs, and attribution

• Lifecycle and CRM tooling, where the pipeline ends in a campaign rather than a table

• Semantic layers for BI tools and AI agents

• Workflow orchestration (Argo Workflows, Airflow, or similar), and enough Kubernetes to debug your own jobs

• Data retention and audit requirements in a regulated environment (SEC, FINRA)

• Experience being an early data engineering hire on a team that scaled

Scope: This role owns the data: pipelines into and out of the warehouse, the models in it, and who can see what. The trading systems, the core clearing ledger, and company infrastructure (cloud, Kubernetes, networking) are owned by engineering and infrastructure teams, and you will work closely with them.

Active Data Stack: Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Fivetran, Segment, Argo Workflows, Datadog

We Offer:

• The opportunity to join a small and growing team of good people, where you can make a difference.

• A new, high-quality code base with little technical debt and room to build new services and features.

• A meritocratic philosophy that champions collaboration.

• Competitive compensation, benefits, and perks.

At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, 401k matching, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical, dental and vision insurance. In-office benefits include lunch stipends, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, a great location, and amazing views.

The Base Salary Range for this role is $150,000 - $250,000.

Our top priority is our people. We're continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse — in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality. #LI-Remote

About Cleerly

We’re Cleerly – a healthcare company that’s revolutionizing how heart disease is diagnosed, treated, and tracked. We were founded in 2017 by one of the world’s leading cardiologists and are a growing team. Most of our teams work remotely and have access to our offices in Denver, Colorado, New, York, New York, Dallas, Texas, and Lisbon, Portugal with some roles requiring you to be on-site in a location.

Cleerly has created a new standard of care for heart disease through value-based, AI-driven precision diagnostic solutions with the goal of helping prevent heart attacks. Our technology goes beyond traditional measures of heart disease by enabling comprehensive quantification and characterization of atherosclerosis, or plaque buildup, in each of the heart arteries. Cleerly’s solutions are supported by more than a decade of performing some of the world’s largest clinical trials to identify important findings beyond symptoms that increase a person’s risk of heart attacks.

At Cleerly, we collaborate digitally and use a wide variety of systems. Our people use Google Workspace (GMail, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides), Slack, Confluence/Jira, and Zoom Video, prior experience in these areas is a plus. Role or department specific technology needs may vary and will be listed as requirements in the job description.

While we are mostly a remote company, travel is required for some team meetings and cross function projects typically once per month or once per quarter, for some roles like sales or external facing roles travel could be up to 90% of the time.

Cleerly is committed to providing safe and effective medical software that meets customer needs and our intended use. The adherence to all applicable regulatory and statutory requirements establishes a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives. Our commitment to continually improving our products and processes proactively manages risks, ensuring ongoing compliance throughout the entire software lifecycle.  Understanding this role's relevance and importance is critical to achieving Cleerly's quality objectives.

About the Opportunity

As a Senior Product Designer, you will employ your mature kit of human centered design methods to facilitate alignment of stakeholders to solutions that meet real user needs.  While you might do some wireframing and interaction design, you are just as much of a user researcher, an insights synthesizer, a problem framer, a sensemaker, a journey mapper, an information architect, and a usability engineer. You are someone who takes initiative, drives your design process, and doesn't wait for internal Product Management or Engineering partners to tell you what is needed.  In this role, you act as an alignment facilitator, leveraging a unique set of tools and skills to guide the team toward delivering user-centered solutions aligned with our mission to transform the standard of cardiac care and eliminate heart attacks worldwide.

About the Team

Cleerly's leadership in cardiovascular care innovation offers significant opportunities for passionate and mission-driven individuals. You will join a high-performing Product Design function that is valued and supported by executive leadership. We are committed to driving measurable impact across our products with a focus on improving customer delight, increasing adoption, and ensuring scalability.

Responsibilities

• End-to-End Product Design: Lead the entire design lifecycle, driving projects from discovery through launch, managing deadlines, and facilitating stakeholder alignment.

• Outcome-Driven Accountability: Directly drive a quantifiable reduction in operational friction by designing highly efficient, scalable, and error-minimized workflow solutions.

• Design Craft & System Stewardship: Apply superior information architecture, interaction, and visual design craft to all deliverables. Actively contribute to and leverage Cleerly’s design system to accelerate product realization and elevate the quality baseline.

• Feasible Design Delivery: Serve as a core partner to Engineering and QA, understanding technical constraints and ensuring that delivered designs are viable for efficient implementation.

• Strategic Influence & Thought Leadership: Serve as thought partner to Product Management, Engineering, and Clinical teams, actively providing informed design perspectives and driving strategic cross-functional decisions.

• Evidence-Based Optimization: Conduct deep discovery-type user research, defining audiences and mapping workflows, to identify friction points and opportunities for improvements within complex multi-user workflows.

• Risk-Based Design: Perform regulatory-compliant human factors engineering activities such as task analysis, use-related risk analysis, risk-based formative usability evaluations, and actively contribute to the cross-functional risk management efforts.

• Design Advocacy & Communication: Employ outstanding communication and storytelling skills to distill complex workflow issues into clear, engaging narratives, actively amplifying the voice and business impact of design company-wide.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• 8+ years of professional experience in Product Design with a strong portfolio and case studies demonstrating expertise in complex B2B, analytics, and dashboarding solutions.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, innovative startup environment where changes are frequent, maintaining a positive attitude toward ambiguity.

• Proven ability to tackle complex products from start to finish with high autonomy, demonstrating a track record of driving and measuring quantifiable improvements in business and user outcomes.

Additional Requirements

• Expert proficiency with Figma’s advanced features and familiarity with AI-powered user research tools for qualitative (e.g. Dovetail) and quantitative research.

• Experience with rapid prototyping leveraging design systems and AI (Figma Make, Figma MCP Server, Lovable, 3Cursor, etc).

• Experience in the HealthTech, SaMD, or other domains with complex data and specialized workflows.

• Experience designing applications involving medical imaging or large-scale scientific data.

• Candidates located in higher-cost labor markets, including California, Washington, New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts, and Washington, DC represent the middle to high end of the range, while candidates located in all other U.S. locations represent the low to middle end of the range.

• Final compensation is determined based on location, experience, skills, and internal equity.

• Base Salary: $166,950 - $192,180

*Total Target Compensation (TTC): Total Cash Compensation (including base pay, variable pay, commission, bonuses, etc.) Additionally, stock options, paid benefits, and employee perks are part of your total rewards.

jobs.title: Head of Talent
jobs.description:
ABOUT KASTLE

Kastle is building the AI employee for regulated finance. We work with some of America's largest banks and mortgage lenders, helping them scale their contact center and compliance operations using autonomous AI Agents that process payments, originate loans, and help customers get a world class experience during the biggest financial decisions of their lives. We've processed over $2 billion in transactions and are backed by Insight Partners and Y Combinator. If you are interested in selling the best product in the market and help large enterprise lenders and banks transform their operations, apply below.


We just raised a $24M Series A and are growing fast!




WHY WE'RE HIRING

We're scaling our team 4x over the next year and need a talent leader to build a world class recruiting and people function. We have the basics in place (ATS, HRIS, benefits), but we need someone who can build strategic HR infrastructure, shape our culture, and partner with leadership on talent decisions.

 


THE ROLE

You'll be our first dedicated people leader, evolving our people function from foundational to strategic. You'll own everything from our sourcing and interview process, performance management to compensation frameworks, and employee relations to culture initiatives. You report to the CEO and partner closely with leadership on all people decisions.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Manage our recruiting team and partner with leadership on hiring strategy and process improvements

 - Own and be responsible for building a recruiting machine that attracts the best talent across engineering, product, GTM, deployments, and operations. 

 - Build and own our people strategy - performance management, compensation, employee development, and culture

 - Partner with leadership on organizational design, headcount planning, and talent decisions

 - Evolve HR infrastructure - refine policies, ensure compliance, optimize benefits programs

 - Design and implement performance management frameworks - goal-setting, reviews, promotion cycles, career development

 - Lead compensation strategy - maintain equitable pay bands, manage equity grants, conduct market benchmarking

 - Drive culture and engagement initiatives - team events, values definition, employee feedback loops, DEI programs

 - Ensure compliance with employment laws and regulations across all locations

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


MUST-HAVES:

 - 5-8+ years in People/HR roles at high-growth startups, with at least 2 years in leadership

 - Experience scaling people functions at early-stage companies (50-200 employees)

 - Track record designing and implementing people processes (performance management, compensation, onboarding, career frameworks)

 - Business partner mentality - you advise leadership on strategic decisions, not just execute HR tasks

 - AI Native. Strong experience working with Claude Code, Cursor, etc to build sourcing agents.

 - Strong coaching skills - you develop managers and help them navigate people challenges

 - Comfort with ambiguity - you build infrastructure without waiting for perfect clarity

 - Excellent judgment on sensitive employee matters


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience in fintech, lending, or regulated industries

 - Background in AI/ML or technical product companies

 - Previous experience scaling a company through hyper-growth (20→200+ employees)

 - Knowledge of multi-state employment compliance

 

At Kastle, we’re building at the edge of AI - fast, focused, and with real ownership. Sprints and major launches move quickly, and we look for people who are energized by that pace. Our team typically works around 70 hours per week, beginning at 8:00 AM, with five days spent collaborating in person at our San Francisco office.

We also offer a benefits package designed to support our full-time employees: medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), and catered lunches and dinners.

jobs.title: Energy Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.



Role Scope

 - Diligence prospective sites across both paths to power, grid interconnection and behind-the-meter generation, and turn each one into a go or no-go recommendation in days rather than weeks.

 - Build and own the delivered cost of power model across candidate sites and both paths, from tariffs and network upgrade exposure on the grid side to gas basis, transport, heat rate, and availability behind the meter.

 - Be the single source of truth on where every site stands, queue position and study milestones on the grid side, contracted fuel and generation position behind the meter, and what has to happen next on each.

 - Run the diligence file on every live site, tariff filings and interconnection studies, pipeline and interconnect agreements, air permits, offtake term sheets, and generation specifications, kept clean enough to walk a counterparty or a lender through cold.

 - Support the Leads through live negotiations with term sheet comparisons, sensitivity runs, counterparty and credit screens, and the one number that decides the question, delivered before the next call rather than after it.

 - Track the markets and the policy that set the rules we build under, ISO large load processes, rate cases and tariff changes, and gas fundamentals in the basins we are buying into.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

 - You've built a model that someone traded, invested, or committed capital off, and you can defend every assumption in it under pressure.

 - You've read a contract, tariff, or study report closely and pulled out the two or three terms that actually change the economics, rather than summarising the whole thing.

 - You turn a disordered data room into a one page recommendation that names the thing the decision actually turns on.

 - You've caught a material error in someone else's work before it reached a decision maker, and you raised it rather than working around it.

 - You've been dropped into a market or an asset class you did not know and been useful inside a few weeks, and you can point to how you got up to speed.

 - You write up what you found the same day you found it, so a site file never depends on what is in your head.

 - Bonus: Commodities trading or analytics desks in gas or power (basis, storage, transport, fundamentals). Origination and structuring teams, especially PPA and offtake work. Large load or generator interconnection across one or more ISOs (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP, WECC). Transaction diligence from M&A, project finance, or infrastructure investing. Behind-the-meter or distributed generation development. Modelling and data tooling (Python, SQL, ICE and CME data, Wood Mackenzie, Velocity Suite).



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.title: Prior Authorization Assistant, Cardiology

Ascertain is building AI agents to automate the administrative work that burdens care teams. We are in major health systems and large specialty groups, saving hundreds of staff hours every week.

Our backers include Northwell Health, New York’s largest health system, and Deerfield Management, a leading healthcare investment firm.

Together, we’re on a mission to restore time, trust, and focus to the people who keep healthcare running. Our work is urgent — not because of startup timelines, but because our customers rely on us to drive financial resilience and operational clarity in a system under strain.

You will continue to process prior authorizations directly—often at high volume—while also serving as a go-to resource for other Ascertain Assistants. Over time, this role will evolve into a hybrid operations + technology position as workflows become increasingly automated and integrated with Ascertain’s platform.

This is not a traditional healthcare shift-based, desk role. It is an outcome-driven position that rewards ownership, judgment, and follow-through.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

As a Prior Authorization Assistant at Ascertain, you will play a critical role in our new AI-powered prior authorization solution. You’ll collaborate directly with Ascertain leadership and product teams, helping to shape how prior authorization is transformed through recent advances in artificial intelligence. You’ll work closely with healthcare providers to reduce administrative burdens and streamline detailed workflows. Day-to-day, this includes manually processing authorizations and overseeing automated submissions for office visit referrals, procedures, pharmaceuticals, and more.  - Review and verify insurance information and patient eligibility for prior authorizations.

Why Ascertain? Make a real difference: Your work will directly impact healthcare organizations and improve patient care. Join Ascertain in transforming healthcare with AI!

Preferred

• Methodical with a keen attention to detail

• Passionate about supporting sales and leadership teams

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
MEET ASCERTAIN

Ascertain is building AI agents to automate the administrative work that burdens care teams. We are in major health systems and large specialty groups, saving hundreds of staff hours every week.

Our backers include Northwell Health, New York’s largest health system, and Deerfield Management, a leading healthcare investment firm.

Together, we’re on a mission to restore time, trust, and focus to the people who keep healthcare running. Our work is urgent — not because of startup timelines, but because our customers rely on us to drive financial resilience and operational clarity in a system under strain.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Operations Coordinator at Ascertain, you’ll own and coordinate key operational workflows across the entire employee lifecycle—from recruiting and onboarding through offboarding—while also supporting executive operations, office logistics, vendor management, and internal systems administration. This is a highly cross-functional role that requires someone who is organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and excited to solve problems in a fast-moving environment.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing people-focused work with operational execution and who thrives in environments where no two days look the same.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Support recruiting and hiring operations by coordinating interview scheduling, candidate communications, resume review, reference checks, offer logistics, background checks, and employment verification processes.

 - Manage end-to-end employee lifecycle operations, including onboarding, first-day orientation, and performance management

 - Oversee internal systems, software access provisioning, role changes, hardware inventory, asset tracking, and vendor relationships across HR, recruiting, and IT operations.

 - Own executive scheduling and calendar coordination, including complex internal/external scheduling, meeting logistics, and travel arrangements.

 - Conduct operational research and analysis, build and maintain reporting, and use spreadsheets and data to identify trends, answer business questions, and support leadership decision-making.

 - Conduct operational research, reporting, and spreadsheet-based analysis to support leadership decision-making and improve organizational processes.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3–5+ years of experience in business operations, startup operations, executive operations, or a similarly cross-functional role, with demonstrated ownership of projects or operational processes.

 - Proven ability to manage complex calendars, priorities, and competing deadlines across multiple stakeholders.

 - Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact professionally across all levels of the organization.

 - Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

 - Experience working with spreadsheets, productivity tools, and operational systems.

 - Comfort handling confidential and sensitive employee information.

 - Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills; comfortable working with operational data, identifying patterns, and turning findings into clear recommendations.

 - Demonstrated ability to take an ambiguous or inefficient process, determine what needs to change, and implement a solution.

Why Ascertain? Make a real difference: Your work will directly impact healthcare organizations and improve patient care. Join Ascertain in transforming healthcare with AI!

jobs.title: Gas Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.



Role Scope

 - Negotiate behind-the-meter PPAs, tolling agreements, and heat rate options with generation owners and developers for multi-hundred-megawatt data center campuses.

 - Negotiate gas supply, transport, and basis arrangements that lock in fuel price and deliverability for each behind-the-meter site before the build starts.

 - Diligence prospective behind-the-meter gas sites for pipeline access, fuel constraints, air permitting, and power delivery risk before we commit to a lease.

 - Evaluate generation equipment (for example turbines and reciprocating engines) on heat rate, availability, lead time, emissions, and delivered cost, and turn it into a clear recommendation for leadership.

 - Quarterback development, engineering, legal, and finance from site selection through executed supply contracts to energization, and flag cost and schedule exposure before it reaches leadership.


What We’re Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don’t fit this role exactly, tell us where you would https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c.

 - You’ve personally negotiated behind-the-meter PPAs, tolls, or heat rate options where the economics had to hold through project finance and final deal terms.

 - You’ve negotiated gas supply agreements and managed fixed-price, index, and basis exposure, and you know which fuel constraints break a plant’s dispatch.

 - You’ve diligenced a gas-fired site from pipeline access and fuel deliverability through air permits and power delivery, and you know what kills a site early.

 - You’ve compared generation technologies on heat rate, spark-spread economics, and reliability, and your analysis drove an equipment decision.

 - You’ve built the techno-economic models behind these deals and defended the sensitivities to lenders, investors, or executives.

 - You quarterback across engineering, legal, finance, and operations, and you write clearly enough to distill a technical question into a decision and a next step for a CEO.

 - Bonus: Multi-market power experience (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, WECC). Plant dispatch and fuel optimization (generator, asset manager, or trading desk). Large-load and utility interconnection. Pipeline capacity and midstream contracting.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

The Executive Housekeeper is responsible for the overall management and operation of the Hotel Housekeeping Department. The position ensures that guest rooms, public areas, back-of-house areas, and other hotel facilities are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, presentation, safety, and guest satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

1. Housekeeping Operations

• Plan, organize, and supervise daily housekeeping operations.
• Ensure guest rooms and public areas meet established cleanliness and presentation standards.
• Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms, corridors, public areas, back-of-house areas, and housekeeping facilities.
• Ensure rooms are prepared and released according to hotel standards and operational requirements.
• Coordinate with Front Office regarding room status, arrivals, departures, VIP guests, room moves, and special requests.
• Establish and maintain effective cleaning procedures, checklists, and quality standards.
• Ensure proper handling of lost and found items.

2. Team Leadership & Staff Management

• Recruit, train, coach, and develop housekeeping employees.
• Prepare staff schedules, assignments, and daily work plans according to occupancy and business needs.
• Conduct daily briefings and communicate operational priorities to the team.
• Monitor employee performance, attendance, grooming, and discipline.
• Provide regular performance feedback and recommend training or development programs.
• Maintain a positive, professional, and service-oriented working environment.

3. Quality & Guest Satisfaction

• Maintain consistent hotel cleanliness and housekeeping standards.
• Respond promptly to guest complaints and special requests related to housekeeping.
• Follow up on guest feedback and implement corrective actions where required.
• Work closely with other departments to resolve guest and operational issues.
• Support the hotel's guest satisfaction and service quality objectives.

4. Inventory & Cost Control

• Monitor housekeeping supplies, linen, uniforms, guest amenities, chemicals, and operating equipment.
• Maintain appropriate inventory levels and establish par-stock requirements.
• Control departmental expenses and minimize unnecessary consumption and wastage.
• Conduct regular inventory and linen counts.
• Monitor the condition and usage of housekeeping equipment and arrange repairs or replacement when necessary.
• Work with Purchasing and Finance to manage departmental procurement and budgets.

5. Hygiene, Safety & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with hotel hygiene, sanitation, health, safety, and environmental standards.
• Ensure cleaning chemicals are stored, labeled, and used correctly.
• Conduct regular checks of housekeeping equipment and work areas.
• Ensure employees follow proper occupational health and safety procedures.
• Implement appropriate procedures for emergencies, accidents, and hazardous situations.

6. Administration & Reporting

• Prepare housekeeping departmental reports, schedules, forecasts, and budgets.
• Monitor occupancy-related staffing requirements and productivity.
• Maintain accurate records for inventory, linen, uniforms, equipment, maintenance issues, and lost and found.
• Participate in management meetings and communicate departmental performance and challenges.
• Develop and update housekeeping SOPs and operational procedures.

7. Interdepartmental Coordination

• Coordinate closely with Front Office, Engineering, Food & Beverage, Security, Human Resources, and other departments.
• Communicate room maintenance issues to Engineering and follow up until completion.
• Support hotel events, VIP arrivals, group arrivals, and special functions.
• Participate in hotel-wide projects and initiatives as assigned by management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Guest satisfaction and housekeeping-related guest feedback
• Guest room cleanliness scores
• Public area cleanliness standards
• Room turnaround and readiness
• Housekeeping productivity
• Departmental budget and cost control
• Linen and amenity consumption
• Staff attendance and turnover
• Training completion and employee performance
• Compliance with hygiene, safety, and hotel SOPs

Knowledge and Experience

• Diploma/Degree in Hospitality Management or related fields preferred (equivalent operational experience highly valued)
• Deep knowledge of housekeeping chemicals, modern cleaning equipment, and fabric/laundry care standards
• Minimum 3-5 years of experience as Executive Housekeeper in 5-star hotels or luxury resorts
• Good command of English (especially for cross-department communication and handling guest requests)
• Proficient in Hotel PMS (e.g., Opera, Smile) and basic MS Office (Excel, Word) for scheduling and inventory tracking

jobs.title: Staff FrontEnd Engineer - Platform - App Core Usage | US | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity:

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise.

The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculations, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts.

This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana Cloud scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana Labs also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope.

What You’ll Be Doing:

The Usage squad owns the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations and customer usage calculations. Our domain encompasses maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, cost management and billing applications, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the customer user portal.

Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. We build full-stack web applications, customer portals, backend services, APIs, and data integrations across internal Grafana platforms and third-party systems like NetSuite and Salesforce. When this domain works well, customers get clear usage visibility, reliable billing, and seamless account management workflows. This role is about 75% FrontEnd and 25% BackEnd.

• Design, build, operate, and evolve reliable full-stack web applications, customer-facing account portals, and backend services that power core customer usage and billing workflows

• Build and maintain backend APIs (Golang, Node.js) and intuitive user interfaces using modern frontend technologies (TypeScript, React)

• Design and maintain integrations between Grafana systems and external business platforms such as NetSuite, Salesforce, and cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Develop and automate business logic for customer usage metering, pricing structures, promotions, and billing reconciliation

• Collaborate across product management, DealOps, GTM, Support, and adjacent AppCore squads to deliver robust end-to-end features

• Address technical debt, optimize CI/CD pipelines, strengthen test coverage, and improve system observability and operational resilience

• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers while shaping pragmatic solutions for complex systems challenges

• Contribute to roadmap planning, technical design, OnCall improvements, and long-term simplification of stack operations

• You will help own the production behavior of the systems you build. That includes improving runbooks, dashboards, alerts, reconciliation safety, rollout controls, and recovery procedures. You should be comfortable debugging across service boundaries and making careful changes in systems that affect customer stacks

What Makes You a Great Fit:

At Grafana, we actively embrace AI-assisted and agentic development practices, integrating these technologies into both our engineering workflows and the systems we deliver. We encourage our engineers to thoughtfully leverage AI tools to enhance every stage of the lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, documentation, and operations. We also look for strategic opportunities to embed agentic capabilities within our services to eliminate toil, bolster reliability, and ensure that complex customer workflows remain resilient and safe.

We are seeking a Staff FullStack Engineer who thrives on building production systems where correctness, scalability, and user experience are paramount. As a remote-first organization, you should be comfortable collaborating asynchronously across time zones and taking full ownership of the critical systems powering Grafana Cloud. Our team is small and operates with a high degree of independence; you will be expected to lead major projects, coordinate across service boundaries, and help define the technical direction for our domain.

You will be particularly successful in this role if you enjoy solving challenges related to stateful systems, eventual consistency, and reconciliation loops. We value engineers who can take ambiguous lifecycle requirements and transform them into explicit, modular solutions. You should be adept at breaking down complex systems work into safe, iterative increments while clearly communicating technical tradeoffs to both internal stakeholders and adjacent product teams.

Some things you might be expected to do could include:

• Writing efficient, readable, and easy to maintain code

• Designing new microservices or systems

• Collaborating with teammates and other departments to reach consensus on proposed solutions

• Coordinating with product and UX when needed

• Responding to customer requests and feedback

• When ready, participating in our follow-the-sun OnCall rotation

• Participating in team decisions, such as roadmap planning and prioritization

Requirements:

• You have at least 1 year of fully remote work experience

• You have worked on a big SaaS platform and dealt with common distributed systems problems (e.g. scalability, multi-tenancy, data isolation, HA, …)

• Strong professional experience with backend technologies (Golang, Node.js) as well as modern frontend web development (TypeScript, React)

• Care deeply about developer and user experience and the quality of the products that you work on

• Have some experience with delivering projects from gathering requirements, and brainstorming ideas to shipping a product to the customer’s hands in a self-driven way

• You write clean, robust, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, operate, and maintain

• Have experience with mentoring junior engineers in a collaborative but asynchronous environment

• Can take on complex challenges and break them down to achieve tight learning loops: to analyze, design, and build modular solutions, deliver MVPs, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively

• You are willing to work across teams. Your work has to be aligned with the needs of other squads and external stakeholders. You make your plans transparent, bring stakeholders on board, and are open to feedback and suggestions

• Strong Kubernetes experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.)

Bonus Points For:

• Experience with high-volume usage metering, billing engines, or customer-facing cost management applications

• Experience designing, building, and maintaining integrations with third-party business systems (e.g., NetSuite, Salesforce, Cloud Marketplaces)

• Experience with frontend component libraries, design systems, and modern CSS-in-JS tooling

• Familiarity with cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, Azure, GCP) and SaaS provisioning/tenancy patterns

• Experience working on SaaS provisioning, tenancy, regional expansion, plugin rollout, or customer lifecycle systems

• Experience with incident response involving configuration drift, partial failure, or cross-service state mismatch

In the United States, the compensation range for this role is $174,986 - $209,983 USD.  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

• 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

• Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

• Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.

• Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

• Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.

• Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.

• Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

• Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.

• Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.

• In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

• Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law.
